We need this charge field to be flexible and allow values starting from ₹0, instead of enforcing a minimum ₹100 charge.

Required Change:

* Minimum charge should be ₹0.
* User should be able to enter any applicable charge amount (₹0, ₹50, ₹100, ₹150, etc.).
* There should be no mandatory minimum
